company_profile: Twilio is a cloud communications platform that helps businesses and developers build personalised customer conversations over voice and messaging.
title: Machine Learning Engineer
summary: Machine Learning Engineer with 8+ years taking ML and LLM systems from prototype to production across Healthcare, Telecom and AIOps. Builds end-to-end ML pipelines and deployed services in Python and PyTorch, from feature engineering to serving with FastAPI, Docker and MLflow, and puts LLMs inside real software through LangGraph agents, RAG, fine-tuning and automated evaluation with tracing. Explains complex models clearly to technical and business stakeholders. Alongside this, I am building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD.

project.name: Conversation Intent and Summary Pipeline
bullets: Built a conversation analytics pipeline that extracted intents, topics and summaries from customer chat and call transcripts using a fine-tuned BERT classifier and an LLM summarizer.
Evaluated outputs against labelled test sets and LLM evaluators, tracked experiments in MLflow, and served the models through FastAPI in Docker with latency and quality metrics logged.

paragraphs: I am applying for the Machine Learning Engineer role on the Conversation Intelligence team. As a senior machine learning engineer I take language models from prototype to production services, most recently an extraction agent that handles about 1,800 lab documents. What ties my work together is turning messy text into something a business can act on.

Twilio sits inside a huge number of customer conversations, and making sense of voice and messaging data at that scale is the problem I want to spend my next years on. There is a personal side too: my fiancée lives in Berlin, and we plan to move to Ireland together and settle there long term, so a remote role from Ireland fits us well.

I would bring the habits of shipping and running ML services. In telecom I built an SLA breach prediction service with LightGBM, FastAPI and MLflow that cut downtime by 67%. In healthcare I built evaluation and tracing pipelines for question-answering agents that reduced human review by 43%, because the monitoring matters as much as the model.

Outside work I am building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD. It has taught me to build for real users, test carefully and listen when something does not work for them. I would be glad to talk about how I could help your team.
